The instrument of sanctification ('through thy truth') Cyril identifies as the apostolic Word given by Christ to the Church — the deposit that the Spirit teaches into all truth (16:13). The closing 'thy word is truth' Cyril takes with full force: the Word (the eternal Logos) IS the truth, and the spoken word (the apostolic Scripture) participates in that truth. This grounds the patristic-Tewahedo doctrine of Scripture's truth as Christ's own truth mediated.
